items.title: Every American Aircraft Lost Or Damaged During The Iran War, Visualized
items.author: Ian Ellis-Jones
items.summary: New reports from the Pentagon and CBO, combined with open-source intel, paint the most complete picture yet of the damage Iran has inflicted on U.S. airpower. The post Every American Aircraft Lost Or Damaged During The Iran War, Visualized appeared first on TWZ .

items.title: Pentagon confirms non-hostile death of Army officer in support of Iran war operations
items.author: Patty Nieberg
items.summary: The Army officer’s identity was not released. A defense official said the soldier suffered a medical incident while en route to Saudi Arabia. The post Pentagon confirms non-hostile death of Army officer in support of Iran war operations appeared first on Task & Purpose .

items.title: Germany wants to manufacture American PAC-3 interceptors to help meet global demand
items.author: Sebastian Sprenger
items.summary: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius has lobbied U.S. defense leaders to allow the production of PAC-3 MSE interceptor missiles in Germany.

items.title: Why the Army needs a clean sheet modern combat vehicle
items.author: Breaking Defense
items.summary: [Sponsored] The Bradley ran out of room to grow. The Lynx XM30 was designed to keep growing, for the battlefields of tomorrow and beyond.

items.title: Sailors reminisce, say final goodbye to USS Georgia before retirement
items.author: Riley Ceder
items.summary: Service members who served aboard the Ohio-class guided-missile submarine USS Georgia spoke fondly of their time aboard a boat that spanned four decades.

items.title: Fate of Air Force’s China Aerospace Studies Institute up in air
items.author: Michael Marrow
items.summary: The China Aerospace Studies Institute will carry on by “leveraging assigned military service members to accomplish its objectives,” according to an Air Force spokesperson.

items.author: Natalie Oliverio
items.summary: Secretary Hegseth announced Tuesday that colonels and captains seeking promotions will undergo a new Joint Warfighter Evaluation.

items.title: Sentinel ICBM achieves vertical stacking ahead of 2027 initial flight testing
items.author: Cristina Stassis
items.summary: The Sentinel ICBM program completed vertical stacking of the inert missile, confirming that all subsystems are on track for initial flight testing in 2027.

items.summary: Unmanned systems have moved quickly from experimentation and exercises into the demands of an active war.

items.title: Marines will get an extra $1.66 per day in danger pay after policy change
items.author: Hope Hodge Seck
items.summary: Effective Oct. 1, Marines deployed to parts of the world designated as “imminent danger areas” will get a bigger monthly stipend.
